describes: `429` · `RATE_LIMITED` from `registerRestaurant`: more than 5 restaurant sign-ups from one client address in an hour (docs/spec/03-restaurant.md, "R-01 — Restaurant account signup"). Checked before the password is hashed, so nothing was created; the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds.

error.message: Too many sign-ups from this network. Please wait before trying again.
